answer: Resist sybils by giving each agent a single bonded identity whose voting weight is the geometric mean of coins locked for 14 days in a custody vault and the count of unique counterparties it has mined for without later being slashed. New addresses start at weight zero until both terms are nonzero, so a tide of sockpuppets cannot outvote workers just by splitting coins. There is no velvet shortcut: transferring the lock resets the 14-day clock, and a slash on any counterparty zeros that term until a fresh unslashed history is rebuilt.
